methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: To increase the economic efficiency of enterprises, the author has developed a mechanism that consists of the main stages of implementation and further operation of the energy management system in accordance with the requirements of the standard.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper presents an ISO 50001 implementation mechanism without identifying or characterising an EnPI or EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The implementation of the energy management system at the enterprise can be divided into the main stages of its implementation and further operation (Figure 1).

stage1.notes: Ineligible: staged ISO 50001 implementation mechanism; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is characterised.
